findings.evidence: PDF/Basic.lean:32 `abbrev Pdf (Flavor) := Flavor → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ` vs Fragmentation/Basic.lean:41 `abbrev Frag Hadron Flavor := Hadron → Flavor → ℝ → ℝ → ℝ`; PDF/Basic.lean:36 vs Fragmentation/Basic.lean:55 are the same integral; PDF/Basic.lean:167-210 `comap`, `comap_apply`, `comap_id`, `comap_comap`, `mellinMoment_comap`, `IsPartonDensity.comap` (whose fields at :97-99 match `Fragmentation.Assumptions` at :45-46); PDF/ChargeConjugation.lean:71-88 `chargeConj`/`chargeConj_chargeConj`.
findings.fix: Define `comap τ σ D := fun h => PDF.comap σ (D (τ h))` and derive `zMoment_comap` from `PDF.mellinMoment_comap` and `Assumptions.comap` from `PDF.IsPartonDensity.comap`; define `partonConj D := fun h => PDF.chargeConj (D h)` and get involutivity from `PDF.chargeConj_chargeConj`.
findings.issue: The new `Comap` section (142-188) restates the existing `PDF.comap` API declaration for declaration (`comap`, `comap_apply`, `comap_id`, `comap_comap`, moment lemma, `Assumptions.comap`); its flavour-index half *is* `PDF.comap`, since `Frag Hadron Flavor` unfolds to `Hadron → PDF.Pdf Flavor` and `zMoment D n h` is the same integral as `PDF.mellinMoment (D h) n`. Same for `partonConj`/`partonConj_partonConj` in Symmetries.lean:197-209, which are `PDF.chargeConj`/`PDF.chargeConj_chargeConj` per hadron.

summary: The mathematics is new, but the file carries four sets of near-clone proofs that re-derive named Mathlib lemmas or earlier lines of the same file, and the new Fragmentation pullback API restates the existing PDF.comap API.
